entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the product you're calling about?
Mark Peterson. It's the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your account now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I just don't like it. It's really hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Could you tell me a bit more about what you're finding difficult?
The whole menu system is just confusing. I read the user manual, and it didn't help. I just expected more, I guess.
I see. It can definitely be frustrating when a new gadget isn't as intuitive as you'd hope. Let me just take a moment to review the return eligibility for your order.

Okay, Mark, thank you for your patience. I see here that your VeloBand was delivered 25 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days, so you're unfortunately outside that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Fine. Just send me the label.

Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
